contract.seed: Startup points the cursor at HUD_INTERACTION_FRAME_SEQUENCE at 0x000029A6.
contract.consumer: Render_BuildActorRecords reads and advances the cursor while building interaction/HUD records.
contract.sentinel: The zero terminator at 0x000029DE causes the cursor to wrap to 0x000029A8.

conclusion: FF7DA8 is a transient HUD frame-table cursor, not an actor or scene pointer.
